name: Dublin City University
description: Dublin City University is a public university in north Dublin, opened in 1980 as the National Institute for Higher Education, Dublin, and granted university status in 1989. It has about 18,000 students across five faculties including business, engineering and computing, and education.
whyIncluded: DCU is one of Ireland's public universities, and Ireland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 270 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: Dublin City University's own estimate of rent, bills, food, transport and personal costs for a student living away from home, for the 9-month academic year (2025/26 figures).
livingCosts.notes: DCU Student Support 'Cost of attending University 2025/2026 - living away from home' (dated 25 June 2025), monthly averages: housing = rent for a single room EUR 796 + gas/electricity/oil EUR 125 + internet EUR 30 + bin charges EUR 18; food = groceries/toiletries EUR 200 + campus meals EUR 120; transport = local transport EUR 92 + weekend travel outside Dublin EUR 140; personal = phone EUR 27 + medication EUR 22 + college materials EUR 10 + books EUR 24 + TV licence EUR 13 + extra-curricular EUR 45 + clothing and social EUR 145. DCU's own monthly total is EUR 1,822 (EUR 16,398 for September-May). No 2026/27 version was published when checked.
